'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[March 2025 Western Syria clashes]]
****At least 16 members of the [[Syrian Armed Forces|security forces]] and 28 [[Bashar al-Assad|Assad]] loyalists are killed in a series of [[ambush]]es and [[shootout]]s in [[Latakia Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/06/syria-forces-say-clashing-with-gunmen-affiliated-with-an-al-assad-era-commander (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20250306-deadly-clashes-erupt-between-syrian-forces-and-remnants-of-assad-s-militias (France 24)]
**Four smuggling suspects are killed in clashes between [[Jordan–Syria border|Jordanian border]] forces and armed groups attempting to cross from [[Syria]]. [https://www.newarab.com/news/jordanian-forces-clash-smugglers-syria-border (''The New Arab'')]
**[[Save the Children]] says that [[landmines]] and [[unexploded ordnance]] in Syria have killed or injured at least 188 children since the [[Fall of the Assad regime|overthrow of President Bashar al-Assad]] in December 2024. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/03/06/syria-leftover-explosives-kill-and-injure-over-180-children-ngo (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Dutch Prime Minister]] [[Dick Schoof]] announces [[United States dollar|US$]]3.8 billion in national military funding for [[Ukraine]] in 2026, including $700 million in Dutch [[Drone warfare|drone]] manufacturing. [[Norway|Norwegian]] and [[Poland|Polish]] leaders also announce increases in military aid for Ukraine. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/zelenskyy-arrives-emergency-europe-summit-amid-pressure-us/story?id=119503760 (ABC News)]
*[[Rohingya genocide]]
**The [[United Nations]] [[World Food Programme]] announces that it will reduce the [[emergency rations|emergency food rations]] for [[Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh]] from US$12.50 to $6 per person. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/6/un-to-halve-rohingya-food-aid-in-bangladesh-amid-funding-crunch (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali civil war]]
**[[Turkish Airlines]] and [[Qatar Airways]] temporarily suspend flights to [[Aden Adde International Airport]] in [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], following security warnings from the [[Embassy of the United States, Mogadishu|United States embassy]] about potential terrorist attacks targeting the airport. [https://www.aerotime.aero/articles/turkish-airlines-qatar-airways-somalia-mogadishu (AeroTime)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Mar/200547/u_s_embassy_warning_triggers_flight_cancellations_by_turkish_airlines_and_qatar_airways_to_mogadishu.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Second Trump tariffs]]
**[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
***Following phone calls between [[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Donald Trump]], [[President of Mexico|Mexican President]] [[Claudia Sheinbaum]], and [[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]], Trump announces a pause on some tariffs on both [[Canada]] and [[Mexico]] until April 2. Sheinbaum states that Mexico will collaborate with the [[United States]] on [[Immigration policy of the United States|migration]] and security issues, including controlling [[Mexico–United States border|cross-border]] [[fentanyl]] smuggling. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/live-updates/trump-2nd-term-tariffs-ukraine/?id=119377651 (ABC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/us-updates-trump-delays-most-tariffs-on-mexico/live-71850905 (DW)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/trudeau-trump-trade-war-deal-1.7476311 (CBC)]
*[[2020s European re-armament]]
**[[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] announces that [[Spain]] will accelerate defense spending to 2% of its [[Gross domestic product|GDP]] in four years. [https://www.elmundo.es/espana/2025/03/07/67c9f301e9cf4ad2698b45b3.html (''El Mundo'')]
*U.S. President Donald Trump signs an [[executive order]] creating a Strategic [[Bitcoin]] Reserve funded exclusively with bitcoin seized in criminal and civil [[asset forfeiture|forfeiture]] cases. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/03/06/trump-signs-executive-order-for-us-strategic-bitcoin-reserve.html (CNBC)]
*NBCUniversal ends broadcasting for [[Universal Kids]] [https://www.variety.com/2025/tv/news/universal-kids-shut-down-march-cable-network-nbcu-1236273553/]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pocheon bombing]]
**Two [[Republic of Korea Air Force|South Korean Air Force]] [[General Dynamics F-16 Fighting Falcon|KF-16]] jets erroneously release eight [[Mark 82 bomb|MK82 bombs]] over home territory in [[Pocheon]], [[Gyeonggi Province]], striking a residential area and multiple homes, injuring at least 15 people, four of them seriously. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/seven-hurt-south-korea-after-shell-lands-civilian-area-during-military-drills-2025-03-06/ (Reuters)]
*At least two people are killed and 186 others are missing after four boats carrying [[Emigration from Africa|African migrants]] heading towards the [[Arab Gulf states]] capsize off the coast of [[Yemen]] and [[Djibouti]]. Two [[Yemenis|Yemeni]] crew members are rescued by the [[International Organization for Migration]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/7/two-dead-186-missing-after-four-boats-sink-off-yemen-and-djibouti-un (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*According to a report in the [[academic journal]] ''[[Science (journal)|Science]]'', the population of the 554 recorded species of [[butterflies]] in the U.S. have declined by 22% since 2000. [https://www.npr.org/2025/03/06/nx-s1-5317535/butterfly-numbers-have-fallen-by-nearly-a-quarter-since-2000 (NPR)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|French defense Minister]] [[Sebastien Lecornu]] says [[France]] will continue sharing military intelligence to [[Ukraine]] regarding the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian invasion]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-russia-military-intelligence-france-lecornu-kyiv-96e3838b673270ccd38917d853031114 (AP)]
*The United States withdraws from the [[Just Energy Transition Partnership]], a program that helps [[Emerging market|emerging countries]] transition away from [[non-renewable resource|non-renewable energy sources]] like [[fossil fuels]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-exits-93-billion-climate-deal-with-developing-nations/a-71847744 (DW)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/us-withdrawing-plan-help-major-polluters-move-coal-sources-2025-03-05/ (Reuters)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[North Korea]] halts foreign [[Tourism in North Korea|tourism]] weeks after reopening to [[Western  world|Western]] visitors. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/north-korea-halts-foreign-tourism-weeks-reopening-western-visitors-rcna195065 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[government of Sudan]] files a [[lawsuit]] in the [[International Court of Justice]] against the [[United Arab Emirates]] for its alleged support of the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and its complicity in [[genocide]] against the [[Masalit people]] in [[Darfur]], [[Sudan]]. The UAE denies its involvement in Sudan and calls the lawsuit a "[[publicity stunt]]". [https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/sudan-launches-case-against-uae-icj-over-complicity-genocide (Middle East Eye)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/6/sudan-files-case-against-uae-at-top-un-court-over-complicity-in-genocide (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[European Court of Justice]] fines [[Germany]] {{Euro}}34 million (US$36.7 million) for failing to implement a [[European Union]] law to protect [[whistleblowers]] by 2021. The Court also fines [[Czechia]] {{Euro}}2.3 million, [[Hungary]] {{Euro}}1.5 million, and [[Luxembourg]] and [[Estonia]] {{Euro}}500,000 each for the same reason. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-fined-34-million-for-late-whistleblower-protection/a-71843936 (DW)]
*Six individuals, including retired [[Romanian Armed Forces|general]] and [[far-right]] politician {{ill|Radu Theodoru|ro}}, are arrested on accusations of being involved in a [[Russia]]n-backed [[coup d'état]] plot in [[Romania]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/414d9140-05e1-4f80-83de-4d7421134f57 (''The Financial Times'')] [https://www.politico.eu/article/romania-foils-revolution-pro-russia-group-featuring-101-year-old-man-holocaust-denying/ (Politico)]

'''Science and technology''' 
*[[2025 in spaceflight]]
**[[Starship flight test 8]]
***[[SpaceX]] launches its [[Starship flight test 8|eighth test flight]] of the [[SpaceX Starship|Starship launch vehicle]] from [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]]. The [[SpaceX Super Heavy|first stage]] was caught by the launch tower despite [[SpaceX Raptor|Raptor]] engine failures during landing, but the second stage failed during its burn, mirroring the [[Starship flight test 7|last flight test]] in January. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/spacex-launches-eighth-starship-test-eyeing-ships-mock-satellite-deployment-2025-03-06/ (Reuters)]
**[[Intuitive Machines]]' space probe [[IM-2|IM-2 ''Athena'']] lands on [[Mons Mouton]] near the [[lunar south pole]] after launching from [[Kennedy Space Center]] in [[Florida]], U.S., on February 27. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c871eeez0yzo (BBC News)]
**An [[Ariane 6]] rocket launches [[French Armed Forces|French military]] satellite [[Composante Spatiale Optique|CSO-3]] from [[Guiana Space Centre]] in [[French Guiana]]. It is the first commercial launch of the Ariane 6 [[expendable launch system]]. [https://apnews.com/article/space-ariane-rockets-satellites-military-2ce8b2a7348997ecd22cd6467bc62c25 (AP)]
